explication: SQLite.swift is a Swift wrapper over SQLite3, offering both typed SQL construction and a lightweight SQL-string interface. In the main workflow, an application builds a typed query, runs it through a connection, and reads typed values from returned rows. The library also exposes schema inspection and migration, database configuration and maintenance, and optional search and encryption features. The graph uses README claims and sampled source; subsystem links without direct evidence of their internal wiring are omitted.
